usage: CodeScene code health rules for iq. Go test code (table tests, fuzz targets and their reference evaluators) checks one invariant per branch or per table row, so it gets a higher complexity threshold, a higher function length threshold (Large Method, 250 lines instead of the default 80) and no nesting rule. Low Cohesion and Overall Function Size are off for test files: a test file follows the functions of the file it tests, and its table tests are long by design. These two rules have no threshold, only a weight. Production code keeps the default rules. The names come from CodeScene's default rules for Go (default-rules.zip, code-health-rules.go.json).

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: Go test files anywhere in the repository.
